visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with black hair tied back, wearing large sunglasses and a light blue denim jacket over a pink top, waves toward the camera while smiling. The background is filled with dense pink cherry blossoms and a glimpse of a wooden roof under a clear, bright sky. (2) The scene cuts to a scenic wide shot of a mountain valley. Lush green conical bushes line a path where several people are walking, all framed by layers of vibrant pink cherry blossoms that stretch across the landscape. (3) A dark-stained wooden cabin is shown, with its balcony overlooking the cherry blossom-filled valley. A white umbrella and some outdoor furniture are visible on the deck as the camera pans slightly. (4) The camera moves inside a cozy room with natural wood walls and ceilings. A bed with white sheets and a single grey pillow is positioned near a large window that perfectly frames the pink trees and distant blue mountains. (5) An outdoor wooden deck is featured, containing long picnic-style tables and benches. At the far end, a wicker hanging swing chair with orange cushions sits among the blossoms, offering a place for relaxation. (6) Two children, a young girl and a boy, are seen sitting on a rustic wooden bench under the shade of cherry trees, looking out at the scenery. (7) Close-up shots of a wooden counter show a small coffee stand area with white banners hanging, featuring mountain and coffee cup icons, surrounded by blooming trees. (8) Several white plates of traditional breakfast side dishes, including dark seaweed, shredded bamboo shoots, and fried gluten, are presented on a wooden table. The woman reappears at the end, giving a thumbs-up gesture and smiling warmly.
